scope: Read-only legacy code/aggregate metrics/identity audit plus synthetic gradient probes

configuration.feature_scaling: L_t coordinate means and one global centered RMS; squared distance divided by feature dimension
configuration.optimizer: L-BFGS-B exact float64 marginal likelihood; maxls20 maxcor10 ftol1e-9 gtol1e-5
configuration.linear_optimizer_exception: reuse Phase0 three fixed starts; report separately as kernel sensitivity
configuration.projection_weight_initialization: N(0,1/input_dim), zero bias, ELU, no response-independent regularizer
configuration.fusion: train-only zscore+PCA64 each GNN/LLM block, train RMS block normalization, concatenate128; same 8256 projection parameters as GNN128->64
configuration.evaluation: 416 previously used validation rows per seed; development evidence only
configuration.primary_metric: paired mean across endpoints of RMSE divided by historical L0 endpoint std
configuration.candidate_rule: SHA256 representation_gp_v1:seed:ID sorting of each current U_t
configuration.llm: local pretrained Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat exploratory frozen causal hidden state; T5 unavailable
configuration.llm_pooling: attention-masked last-hidden-state mean; no chat template; no generation
configuration.stopping: stop on safety/hash/numerical invalidity; preserve finite nonconverged fits and all completed methods; never prune by evaluation score

limitations: Finite differences cover small synthetic float64 systems, not every historical fitted point.

evidence_limits: Current L_t checkpoints were trained on all L_t responses; internal GP train/cal/check splits are conditional representation diagnostics only.
The 416 validation responses participated in QGeoGNN checkpoint selection and repeated method development.
A strict forward test must use future already-revealed rows with features from the pre-acquisition checkpoint, plus immutable acquisition/feedback receipts.
The legacy prepared cache contains only L_t, 256 current U covariates, and 416 development validation covariates; it cannot cover an arbitrary future block.
Projection weights and per-iteration gradient norms were not saved in historical fit JSON; historical geometric collapse/condition numbers cannot be reconstructed without a replay.
All fit/coverage aggregates are descriptive; five seeds share source rows and four budgets are nested.
